title: kate-ui: keep the completion popup state
summary: completion.rs holds the popup: the items and the selected index. popup_from_words builds it from the buffer words, step moves the selection, accepted gives the selected item, and merge_completions puts server items before buffer words without duplicates. suffix_for gives the text to insert after the prefix.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The file has no GPUI import, but kate-ui tests run in the rust (macos-15) job and the Mac lane owns crates/kate-ui.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Create completion.rs with the SPDX header and add mod completion; to lib.rs with the dead_code attribute. The test merge_and_suffix asserts merge_completions([foo, bar], [bar, baz], 5) is [foo, bar, baz], suffix_for("foobar", "foo") is Some(bar), suffix_for("foo", "foo") is None, and that a popup from [a, b] stepped by -1 selects b. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: completion::tests::merge_and_suffix
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because completion.rs does not exist. After the change the merge keeps order without duplicates and the suffix drops the prefix.
